sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS dates, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS total_pnl, round(sum(pnl/quantity)::numeric,4) AS pnl_per_contract, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl<0) AS losses, round(avg(100-assumed_price)::numeric,2) AS avg_entry_c, min(created_at)::date AS first, max(created_at)::date AS last FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) AND market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPSAY%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
